items.name: Tripo Rigging v3.0 / P2.0
items.why: Tripo P2.0 推出，大幅改進了人形綁骨演算法和多種遊戲引擎骨架預設，並正式發佈 Rigging v3.0 API，顯著提升綁骨品質和速度。
items.why_en: Tripo P2.0 launched with significant improvements to humanoid rigging algorithms and multiple game engine skeleton presets, and the formal release of Rigging v3.0 API, greatly enhancing rigging quality and speed.

items.name: Cascadeur
items.why: Cascadeur 2026.2 版本發佈，帶來了 AutoPosing、Motion Generation (原 Root Motion) 和物理模擬的重大更新，使動畫製作更直觀、更真實。
items.why_en: Cascadeur 2026.2 released with major updates to AutoPosing, Motion Generation (formerly Root Motion), and physics simulations, making animation creation more intuitive and realistic.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio
items.why: Autodesk Flow Studio 的 3D Editor + Canvas 功能獲得改進，增強了場景指導和角色表演控制，對於生成式 AI 影片製作中的角色可動化至關重要。
items.why_en: Autodesk Flow Studio's 3D Editor + Canvas received improvements, enhancing scene direction and character performance control, crucial for animating characters in generative AI filmmaking.

items.name: Animcraft
items.why: Animcraft 6.0 引入了全新的 AI 綁骨和蒙皮模組，以及基於片段的文字轉動畫功能，為動畫庫構建工具帶來顯著的新能力。
items.why_en: Animcraft 6.0 introduced new AI rigging and skinning modules, along with clip-based text-to-animation capabilities, bringing significant new features to this animation library building tool.

items.name: Meshy Edit
items.why: Meshy AI 推出了 Meshy Edit 功能，允許用戶透過 AI 精確編輯 3D 模型特定部分，這對於綁骨和動畫前的模型準備工作至關重要。
items.why_en: Meshy AI launched Meshy Edit, allowing users to precisely edit specific parts of 3D models with AI, which is crucial for model preparation before rigging and animation.

items.why_en: Speech-to-speech model designed for real-time AI conversations, excelling in Big Bench Audio benchmark with response times as low as 0.57 seconds.

items.name: Eleven v4 / v4 Turbo

items.why_en: Enhanced updates to ElevenLabs' core text-to-speech models, offering higher quality, more expressive speech, faster real-time use, and improved voice cloning.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS

items.why_en: Google's new flagship text-to-speech model, offering high acoustic fidelity, acting nuance, and broad language support for audiobooks and narration.
